ns2:course.label: Advanced Choral Techniques I
ns2:course.description: Intensive laboratory approach to the development of advanced techniques necessary for working effectively with choral ensembles. Choral majors must enroll each term in residence. 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in choral music or consent of instructor.
